data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2020 were GBP 108.529m. Using the published gross claims development table, exclusion of the two most recent underwriting years (2019 and 2020) shows a net adverse prior-year movement of GBP 3.155m (a strengthening of reserves), representing approximately 2.9% of opening gross claims outstanding. The report attributes the overall 2020 result to adverse claims experience driven particularly by natural catastrophe events and Covid-19 pandemic effects; no explicit single gross prior-year movement sentence was provided in the accounts, so the prior-year movement above is calculated from the gross claims development triangle.
raw_causal_phrases: the impact of adverse claims experience, particularly from natural catastrophes and the losses arising from the Covid-19 pandemic.
This Unexpired risk provision relates to COVID-19 losses.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) figure is calculated from the gross claims development table (claims development triangle) because no explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' sentence/line was found. Triangle is presented in GBP '000; PYD computed by comparing the latest estimate to the previous-diagonal for underwriting years 2017 and 2018 (excluding 2019 and 2020 per instructions). No named prior-year events quantified. The balance sheet claims outstanding figure used for opening reserves is explicit and certain. The report records a Part VII transfer and 100% quota share with LIC effective 30 Dec 2020 for European liabilities but states there was no economic impact and no movements processed on 31 Dec 2020; triangle used nonetheless.
